xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
1.Tata Motors Ltd (TML), the Holding Company of Tata Technologies Ltd, had in August 2024, submitted a composite scheme of arrangement for de-merger of its commercial and passenger vehicle businesses into two listed entities. The Hon'ble NCLT approved the arrangement to take effect from October 01, 2025. As part of the process, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd (TMPVL) has amalgamated with TML and stands dissolved. The company Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd (TMPVL) (Formerly Tata Motors Limited) w.e.f. October 13, 2025 has become the Holding Company/ Promoter of Tata Technologies Ltd. Accordingly, there has been a change in the name of the Promoter from Tata Motors Limited to Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited and the count of Promoter and Promoter Group, in shareholding pattern of the Company, as compared to previous periods/quarters.
2. The Daimler Motor Company Limited, Daimler Transport Vehicles Limited, S.S. Cars Limited and The Lanchester Motor Company Limited are struck-off and holding NIL shares hence removed from promoter group.
3. Jaguar Land Rover Mxico, S.A.P.I. de C.V. has merged into Jaguar Land Rover Servicios Mxico, S.A. de C.V. and holding NIL shares hence removed from promoter group.
4. The promoter divested entire shareholding in Tata Precision Industries (India) Limited and holding NIL shares hence removed from promoter group.
5. With reference to the KMP shareholding, the change in KMP shareholding is consequent to change in the Company Secretary.
